newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Celesc still a Caspian buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Celesc still a Caspian buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities reiterated Tuesday its buy rating on Brazilian state-owned utility Centrais Eletricas de Santa Catarina (Celesc).
-- "Celesc's demand growth, operating improvement and quality of earnings were better than expected," Caspian analyst F. Rowe Michels said.

-- The firm's 35-percent drop in first-half net income to 33.9 million reais, or 44.04 reais per 1,000 shares, was in line with expectations and on target to meet a year-end forecast of 64 million reais, he said.
-- Celesc's preferred B share closed up 1.32 percent at 1.53 reais in Sao Paulo. Itgs common was untraded at 1.58 reais.
